Ava (People Ops): Quick heads-up on remote location changes, WFH stipend, and relocations — please read before you move. TL;DR: domestic moves need pre-approval for relocation grants; WFH stipend stays the same but changes to your tax/state withholding are your responsibility. International moves may trigger a tax nexus review and require Legal + Finance sign-off. Fill the relocation request form before booking anything: https://redwood.example/reloc-request (short form)

Jamal (Eng): Do I need pre-approval for a cross-state move (CA -> WA)? I was planning to take a month to handle logistics.

Ava (People Ops): Yes — pre-approval required for any permanent change of work location. For CA -> WA, it's domestic and typically straightforward, but we still need the form so Payroll can update state withholding and Benefits can confirm eligibility.

Sofia (Finance): Quick note: WA has no state income tax, so your state withholding will change. Please upload an updated federal W-4 and the state form (if applicable) after you submit the reloc form.

Jamal (Eng): Got it. Do I lose the WFH stipend if I move to a different state?

Priya (People Ops): No — the WFH stipend is independent of state for US-based employees. Current policy: $100/mo standard WFH stipend for home office expenses (desk, monitor stand, internet reimbursement guidelines apply). Stipend continues as long as you're an active employee and your role remains remote-eligible.

Jamal (Eng): Thanks. Any changes to benefits eligibility if I cross state lines?

Sofia (Finance): Most benefits remain the same within the US, but medical plan networks can vary. Benefits team will run a quick eligibility check once you submit the move. If you move out of our plan coverage area, we'll discuss options (COBRA, alternate plan enrollment, or regional plan).

Leo (Legal): For international relocations: pause travel/bookings until we confirm tax nexus. If you establish permanent residence in another country we may need to set up local payroll or change employment status. That can affect equity vesting, social security, and tax withholding.

Priya (People Ops): Practical steps for any move: 1) fill reloc request form before you announce/commit travel 2) attach proposed effective date 3) payroll will review withholding requirements 4) Benefits will confirm coverage 5) Legal flags tax nexus for international or multi-state situations.

Ava (People Ops): Relocation grants — domestic: up to $5,000 for qualifying moves (moving household goods, travel for house-hunting, etc.) — one-time and must be pre-approved. International cases are handled case-by-case. For small local moves (same metro), we usually don't approve the grant but can approve a one-time home setup stipend if needed.

Jamal (Eng): If I want help from People Ops to find vendors (movers, temporary housing), do you assist?

Priya (People Ops): We can share vendor lists and a relocation checklist. We don't manage bookings, but we can reimburse pre-approved expenses per the policy. Keep receipts and submit via Expensify with the relocation approval code.

Sofia (Finance): Also: important for payroll — update your address in Workday/payroll and attach the form. If you move across state lines, payroll will run the withholding change effective the next pay period after the effective date you provide.

Jamal (Eng): What about contractors or transfers to contractor status if we move abroad?

Leo (Legal): If you become resident in a jurisdiction where we don't have an entity, we can't simply reclassify you as a contractor without a full legal/compensation review. We'll discuss alternatives but do not assume contractor conversion is automatic.

Payroll Bot: Automated reminder — if the reloc request indicates a new US state, the system will create a payroll task: upload W-4, state withholding form, and updated address within 10 days of move effective date. Failure to provide forms may delay your net pay.

Jamal (Eng): OK — submitting the form now. Effective date target: 2024-05-15.

Ava (People Ops): Thanks @Jamal — once your form is in I'll loop in Sofia and Leo for any flags. If anyone else is planning a move soon, please open the form so we can triage early. :thumbsup:

Sofia (Finance): FYI — if a bunch of people move into the same new state within a short window, Finance + Legal will do a quick nexus check. That rarely affects individuals, but good to know. (reaction: :eyes:)

Priya (People Ops): For quick reference — reloc form link again: https://redwood.example/reloc-request. Home setup/WFH reimbursement policy here: https://redwood.example/wfh-policy. If you have private questions DM People Ops or book a 15-min slot.
